copy.bis: Ang mga modernong e-jeepney sa mga kalsada sa Manila naggamit og electric motors nga adunay electromagnets aron ma-convert ang electrical energy ngadto sa motion!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It uses electromagnets to spin the blades
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the similarities and differences between electric motors and electric generators
assignedReviews.reason: The card only states that an electric motor uses electromagnets; it gives no information about electric generators and no comparison of similarities or differences, so it does not directly support the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It uses electromagnets to spin the blades
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: make a simple electromagnet and observe and record its properties
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions electromagnets in the context of a motor but does not instruct the student to make a simple electromagnet or to observe and record its properties, so it only relates to the topic.

copy.en:
How does the electric motor inside a Philippine standing fan work?

It uses electromagnets to spin the blades and create cool wind!
copy.tl:
Paano gumagana ang electric motor sa loob ng karaniwang Philippine standing fan?

Gumagamit ito ng electromagnets para paikutin ang mga blades at lumikha ng hangin!
copy.bis:
Unsaon paggana ang electric motor sa sulod sa kasagarang Philippine standing fan?

Naggamit kini og electromagnets aron paikot ang mga blades ug maghimo og hangin!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: magnetic forces push the rotor to convert electrical energy into mechanical motion
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the similarities and differences between electric motors and electric generators
assignedReviews.reason: The card only describes how an electric motor converts electrical energy to mechanical motion. It does not mention electric generators or compare similarities/differences between motors and generators, which is the core of the competency.

copy.en: During the spinning stage of an electric motor, magnetic forces push the rotor to convert electrical energy into mechanical motion!
copy.tl: Sa pag-ikot ng electric motor, itinutulak ng magnetic forces ang rotor para i-convert ang electrical energy into mechanical motion!
copy.bis: Sa pag-ikot sa electric motor, ang magnetic forces nag-push sa rotor aron i-convert ang electrical energy into mechanical motion!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: converts kinetic energy into electrical energy
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe kinetic energy as the movement of objects or particles, and potential energy as energy stored due to the position of objects or particles
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions kinetic energy being converted to electrical energy but does not describe kinetic energy as movement of objects/particles nor potential energy as stored energy. It only uses the term without teaching the concept required by the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: driving a generator that converts kinetic energy into electrical energy
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the similarities and differences between electric motors and electric generators
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a generator converting kinetic to electrical energy but does not compare electric motors and generators, nor describe similarities/differences between them.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: How does a wind turbine make electricity?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how high voltage electricity from power plants is generated and safely distributed to industries, businesses, and homes, including the role of substations (grid stations), and electric meters
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains basic wind turbine electricity generation but does not address high voltage transmission, distribution to industries/businesses/homes, substations, or electric meters.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Wind spins large blades, driving a generator that converts kinetic energy into electrical energy
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: gather information from secondary sources to evaluate how renewable and non-renewable generation of electricity in the Philippines impacts human activities and the environment
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes renewable generation but does not evaluate impacts on human activities or the environment, nor does it gather information from secondary sources.

copy.en:
How does a wind turbine make electricity?

Wind spins large blades, driving a generator that converts kinetic energy into electrical energy!
copy.tl:
Paano gumagawa ng kuryente ang wind turbine?

Pinapaikot ng hangin ang malalaking blades, na nagpapatakbo ng generator na nagko-convert ng kinetic energy sa electrical energy!
copy.bis:
Unsaon paghimo og kuryente ang wind turbine?

Ang hangin mopapailaw sa dagkong blades, nagpadagan sa generator nga nagkabig sa kinetic energy ngadto sa electrical energy!

assignedReviews.reason: The card only states that electric motors use electromagnets to spin. It does not mention electric generators or compare similarities/differences between motors and generators, so it does not directly support the competency.

copy.en:
How do electric fans and toys make their parts spin?

The electric motors inside them use electromagnets to make everything spin round and round!
copy.tl:
Paano pinepaikot ng mga electric fan at laruan ang kanilang mga bahagi?

Ginagamit ng mga electric motor sa loob nila ang elektromagnet para paikutin ang lahat!
copy.bis:
Unsaon pagpatuyok sa mga electric fan ug dulaan sa ilang mga bahin?

Ang mga electric motor sa sulod niini naggamit ug elektromagnet aron patuyokon ang tanan!

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the similarities and differences between electric motors and electric generators
assignedReviews.reason: The card only mentions a generator/dynamo converting hand spinning into electricity. It does not describe electric motors, nor compare similarities and differences between motors and generators, so it does not directly support G10-F-11.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A hand-crank flashlight has a tiny generator or dynamo that turns the spinning of your hand into electricity!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify examples of everyday situations that demonstrate: a. kinetic energy being transformed to potential energy, and b. potential energy being transformed to kinetic energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes mechanical spinning being converted into electrical energy, which is a transformation of energy, but it does not specifically identify kinetic energy being transformed to potential energy or potential energy to kinetic energy as required by G8-F-5.

copy.en:
How does a hand-crank flashlight work?

A hand-crank flashlight has a tiny generator or dynamo that turns the spinning of your hand into electricity!
copy.tl:
Paano gumagana ang hand-crank na flashlight?

Ang hand-crank na flashlight ay may maliit na generator o dynamo na ginagawang kuryente ang pag-ikot ng iyong kamay!
copy.bis:
Unsaon pagtrabaho ang hand-crank nga flashlight?

Ang hand-crank nga flashlight adunay gamay nga generator o dynamo nga maghimo sa pagliko sa imong kamot ngadto sa kuryente!
